target_customer: AI platform and ML infrastructure teams running LLM serving, ranking and recommender workloads on GPUs
problem: Finding and fixing CPU-GPU performance bottlenecks takes far longer than writing the fix.
business_model: Developer tooling (VSCode extension and AI performance agent), engineer-led sales

founders.name: Aditya Rajagopal
founders.background_notes: Compiler work; ICML reviewer per YC profile.

founders.name: Diederik Vink
founders.background_notes: AI feasibility consultant, employer not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Analyzing performance across CPU-GPU interactions down to kernels needs deep compiler and hardware expertise, which the PhD founders have.

defensibility.rationale: Specialized expertise is hard to copy, but general coding agents and profilers from GPU vendors can erode the wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against nCompass found in sources.

market_need_then: The YC description says profiling and strategizing fixes takes 4 to 8 times longer than writing code; demand for GPU efficiency was high with the 2023 to 2024 LLM boom, though no dated source was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Engineering focused, Talk to an engineer

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence, and the name collides with older companies named nCompass and Encompass.

pivots.from: API for low latency versions of open source and custom models (earlier positioning per an aggregator)
pivots.to: AI agents that find and fix GPU performance bottlenecks, with a VSCode extension

outcome_analysis: NCompass remained a small team of about three after YC Winter 2024 and moved its positioning from model serving toward an agent for GPU performance engineering. No disclosed funding beyond the YC deal, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unresolved and no factors are supported by the sources.
notes: Aggregators list $500K convertible note or pre-seed with Y Combinator (VCBacked also names Saturnin Pugnet), dated January to April 2024; unverified, so no round recorded. Competitor search returned only academic papers, so the list is empty.
